title: Readiness and identity
settles: the stack is the real, non-fixture, authenticated one

steps.name: served bundle has no fixture adapter (disk scan + HTTP scan)
gateway is the live non-fixture build and the kernel is ready

title: Template to preflight to commit
settles: a case exists in the kernel because the UI committed it

title: Horizon standing
settles: the UI shows the case's real standing, not an invented one

title: Discretionary add
settles: an operator-proposed item is durably in the plan with its proposer, and the UI shows it

title: Execute through the UI
settles: an executed item is durably active, settled and completed, and its downstream unlocks over SSE without a reload

title: Sign-off: operator denied, R-SO approves in a separate session
settles: an approval opened by the operator's execution is resolved only by a distinct R-SO principal, with both principals visible in the durable record

title: Settlement and the evidence dock
settles: a settled item's captured artifact opens in the dock with a verified digest, and only the needed renderer chunk is fetched

title: Lifecycle: close, reopen, terminate
settles: a case closes when its work completes, reopens with a reason, and a second case is terminated with a reason, all as durable kernel events offered only by the snapshot

title: Thoth ask narration: interrupt and resume
settles: a typed question is answered by the real kernel, narrated from the returned disclosure only, interruptible and resumable without a second ask

title: L0-L8 in one session: console and errors stay empty
settles: the whole live ladder ran in one continuous session per user with no error-level console output and no page error

title: Recovery: corrupt artifact, SSE drop, kernel and gateway kill -9
settles: the UI is honest and consistent with the durable files across a corrupt artifact, an SSE drop and kernel/gateway crashes
